Let's verify: White bishop on c3. Squares on the a1-h8 diagonal: a1, b2, c3, d4, e5, f6, g7, h8. Our pieces on that diagonal: knight on d4, pawn on e5. So both are blocking. So the only moves that open the diagonal are e4 (moves pawn, knight remains) or moving the knight AND later the pawn, or capturing something that moves both. But for now, after any knight move or pawn move, the diagonal remains blocked.
